exposure: maternal PV leaking for more than 18 hours
cohort: 100 neonates admitted to the neonatal unit of the Pediatric Department, Jinnah Hospital, Lahore, during the first seven days of life.
finding: Early onset sepsis occurred in 24% of neonates, with E. coli being the most common pathogen, especially in preterm babies.
mod_finding: Majority of neonates were delivered by normal vaginal delivery.
